title: Apricot Amaretto Almond Crumble
notes: You can also use fresh plums, pears, cherries, nectarines or peaches and even swap the Amaretto for another liquour, like Cointreau or Grand Marnier.

methodSections.heading: Dough
steps: In a mixing bowl blend the flour, salt, butter and shortening together with your fingers.
Gradually add the water and bring the dough together but don't over work it.
Wrap in plastic wrap and set aside in fridge to relax for a while.

methodSections.heading: Apricot Filling
steps: Core, peel and dice the apple.
Rinse, pit and slice the apricots with the skins on.
In a bowl mix the fruit together with the sugar, tapioca flour and cinnamon.
Add the orange juice, zest and amaretto and mix thoroughly ensuring all the fruit is coated in the sugar mixture which should dissolve completely.

methodSections.heading: Almond Butter Crumble
steps: Mix all ingredients together in a bowl with your fingers until there are no lumps and it is a consistent crumble.

methodSections.heading: Baking
steps: Roll the dough until it is roughly ½cm (⅓in) thick and a 30cm (12in) circle.
Gently place in a 25cm (10in) diameter pie dish that has sides roughly 3cm (1in) high. Gently push into the dish so the pastry is pressed into the corners.
Trim and shape the edges as desired.
Pile in the fruit, spreading evenly and mounding in the middle.
Pour the crumble on top of the fruit and spread evenly ensuring all the fruit is covered.
Place in the oven pre-heated to 180°C (350°F) and bake for around an hour or until the pie juices bubble.
